question: How do digital (electronic) blood pressure machines mainly measure your blood pressure?

options.A: By placing a small fluid tube inside the artery
options.B: By sensing pulse waves (oscillations) in the cuff
options.C: By feeling the pulse at the wrist directly
options.D: By listening to Korotkoff sounds with a tiny microphone

explanation: Digital machines look for tiny changes or oscillations in pressure caused by your pulse, rather than listening for sounds like we do with a stethoscope. Spot on! [learn more](GNS212_U4_T1#GNS212_U4_T1_h1)

question: Why does a patient moving around during a digital blood pressure check often cause an error?

options.A: Movement stops the battery from sending power to the screen
options.B: Moving completely shuts off the air valve inside the cuff
options.C: Physical activity instantly drops the patient's actual blood pressure
options.D: Movement creates false pressure bumps that confuse the machine's computer

explanation: The machine looks for very steady, specific waves. Any extra shaking or moving creates chaotic signals that mess up the calculation. Keep your patient nice and still! [learn more](GNS212_U4_T1#GNS212_U4_T1_h1)

question: What is one of the best perks of using an electronic blood pressure machine over a manual one?

options.A: They are completely unaffected if the patient moves
options.B: They take very little training to use correctly
options.C: They give exact readings even during serious heart rhythm problems
options.D: They never need new batteries or servicing

explanation: Digital monitors do the heavy lifting for you! You don't need expert stethoscope listening skills to get a quick reading. [learn more](GNS212_U4_T1#GNS212_U4_T1_h2)

question: When would a manual blood pressure check with a stethoscope be a better choice than a digital machine?

options.A: When the patient is checking their own pressure at home
options.B: When the patient has a very irregular heartbeat
options.C: When the hospital ward is completely quiet
options.D: When you are in a rush during a busy shift

explanation: Digital machines struggle to calculate properly when the heart rhythm jumps all over the place. That's when your manual auscultation skills shine! [learn more](GNS212_U4_T1#GNS212_U4_T1_h2)

question: Where should you position the lower edge of the blood pressure cuff on the patient's arm?

options.A: About one inch above the inner elbow crease
options.B: Right up against the shoulder joint

explanation: Placing it about an inch above the elbow crease ensures the inner bladder sits right over the brachial artery. Perfect placement! [learn more](GNS212_U4_T1#GNS212_U4_T1_h3)

question: You get a falsely high blood pressure reading because the cuff you used was way too small for the patient's arm. What should you do next?

options.A: Record the high reading as their true baseline blood pressure
options.B: Switch to measuring the blood pressure on their ankle instead
options.C: Just subtract ten points from the result and write that down
options.D: Grab a larger cuff and repeat the check after giving the patient a short rest

explanation: A wrong cuff size means the reading isn't reliable. Always re-measure with the correct size after letting the patient rest for a minute. [learn more](GNS212_U4_T1#GNS212_U4_T1_h3)

question: Why can crossing the legs during a blood pressure check lead to a falsely high reading?

options.A: It blocks blood flow completely in the arm's brachial artery
options.B: It increases physical tension and blood vessel resistance in the body
options.C: It stops the machine from pumping air into the cuff
options.D: It drains the battery of the electronic device faster

explanation: Crossed legs and slouching temporarily boost your vascular pressure. Always remind patients to uncross their legs and keep feet flat on the floor! [learn more](GNS212_U4_T1#GNS212_U4_T1_h4)

question: Which of these is a MISTAKE when getting a patient ready for a digital blood pressure check?

options.A: Making sure both of the patient's feet are flat on the floor
options.B: Asking the patient to stay quiet while the machine runs
options.C: Allowing the patient to keep a thick sweater on with the cuff rolled over it
options.D: Ensuring the patient rests quietly for five minutes beforehand

explanation: Always put the cuff directly on bare skin! Thick clothing or tight rolling can pinch the arm and mess up your numbers. [learn more](GNS212_U4_T1#GNS212_U4_T1_h4)

question: What is a major giveaway that a digital blood pressure cuff has an air leak?

options.A: The screen flashes bright red and rings a loud alarm
options.B: The battery icon shows full charge the whole time
options.C: The machine shows an error code or cannot finish pumping up
options.D: The device measures the blood pressure twice as fast as usual

explanation: If air is escaping, the machine can't build up the pressure it needs, so it will usually flash an error message at you. [learn more](GNS212_U4_T1#GNS212_U4_T1_h5)

question: Why do electronic blood pressure monitors need to be checked and calibrated regularly?

options.A: Internal sensors naturally drift and lose accuracy over time and with use
options.B: It's just a rule made by manufacturers to keep batteries from exploding
options.C: The internal software wipes its own memory clean every few weeks
options.D: Sensors magically improve their own accuracy without any human help

explanation: Just like weighing scales, electronic monitors can get a bit out of whack over time. Regular checks ensure our numbers stay trustworthy. [learn more](GNS212_U4_T1#GNS212_U4_T1_h5)

question: A digital monitor shows a very high blood pressure for a calm patient who feels totally fine. What is your best immediate nursing action?

options.A: Write down the machine's number and walk away to another room
options.B: Check the reading manually using a stethoscope and manual cuff
options.C: Rush to give the patient strong blood pressure-lowering drugs
options.D: Throw the electronic device away and never use it again

explanation: Machines can glitch! If a result doesn't match how the patient looks or feels, always double-check it manually before panicking or treating. [learn more](GNS212_U4_T1#GNS212_U4_T1_h6)

question: Why is teaching patients how to use home blood pressure monitors such an important nursing duty?

options.A: Patients need to know how to solder broken circuit boards at home
options.B: Good technique prevents false readings that could lead to wrong medication changes
options.C: It stops patients from ever coming back to the hospital clinic
options.D: Home machines are so complicated that only rocket scientists can run them

explanation: If a patient uses poor posture or a bad cuff size at home, their doctor might see bad data and change their prescriptions incorrectly. Your teaching makes a real difference! [learn more](GNS212_U4_T1#GNS212_U4_T1_h6)
